parameters.content:
## Error log
Every AP workflow names this one as its **error workflow**. A failed run (e.g. Gmail or the database unreachable, a missing label) is written to the AP log, so the daily summary shows it. Open the run in n8n's executions list to see the details.

## Log the failed run
Workflow, last node, short error message. Never document data.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [String($json.execution?.id ?? ''), 'workflow failed: ' + ($json.workflow?.name ?? 'unknown'), JSON.stringify({ workflow_id: $json.workflow?.id ?? null, workflow: $json.workflow?.name ?? null, node: $json.execution?.lastNodeExecuted ?? null, mode: $json.execution?.mode ?? null, error: String($json.execution?.error?.message ?? '').slice(0, 300) })] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ap.processing_log (n8n_execution_id, step, level, message, details)
VALUES ($1, 'workflow_error', 'error', $2, $3::jsonb)
